lines.en: I fly the way a person would walk
My shadow hangs beneath my wings

lines.zh: 我拐弯的时候像在转身
lines.en: I turn as if turning my head
I skim along the ghost oaks

lines.zh: 我贴着树干飞，像在走路。
lines.en: I fly along the trunk as if walking.
I weave beneath the canopy
I stop on a low branch
There is a hint of blue on my wings
I look like I am searching for something
I circle the same tree
I dip down, then rise
I head for the gap between trees
I brush past a cross branch
My wingtip touches the leaves
I pause under the canopy
I fly the way the wood runs
I hang upside down from the branch
My face looks a little like a head
I stay still, wings folded
This wood is strangely quiet
I am looking below
My face looks like a person's.
The bark is not comfortable
I do not call, I only watch
I have perched on this tree many times
There is a little wind in the wood

lines.zh: 我把脸转向你，脖子咯吱响。
lines.en: I turn my face to you and my neck creaks.
This is a good place to stay
You have two legs too
I look like you when I fly

lines.zh: 幽魂橡木森林里，我最多两只。
lines.en: At most two of us in the ghost oak forest.
You have two legs too — rare.
I do not quite look like a bat, do I
Looking up at me feels odd
Do you recognize my face

lines.zh: 这林子里的东西都记得你
lines.en: Everything here remembers you

lines.zh: 你手上的东西跟你一样
lines.en: What you hold looks like you

lines.zh: 别把我当成普通的蝙蝠
lines.en: Do not take me for an ordinary bat
I slip past your fingers and away.
One wing is crooked and I spin.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从枝上打落。
lines.en: The blow knocks me off the branch.
I land on a branch to catch my breath
I turned like a person would
I did not call out
My wing is missing feathers
I hide in the tree shadow
I can still fly with this
I keep looking your way
These do not interest me
This smells like people food
What are you holding it up for
I do not really need to eat
Set it down and I will look

lines.zh: 我掉玩家的头，这事不假。
lines.en: I drop player heads. That much is true.
Keep it, you need it more
I sniffed it, not bad
Taking it would do me no good

lines.zh: 林子里的东西我都见过
lines.en: I have seen everything in this wood

lines.zh: 你的肩撞得我翅膀一折。
lines.en: Your shoulder folds my wing.

lines.zh: 我像个人一样晃了一下
lines.en: I swayed like a person would
That set the leaves moving

lines.zh: 我往后飘了半尺，像人退步。
lines.en: I drift back half a foot like a person stepping away.
Your shoulder hit my claws
We both stopped
I flew past your face
That felt strange
You backed away faster than I did
I land on the branch beside you
There are few of us in this wood

lines.zh: 另一只也像人，我看见了
lines.en: I saw another that also looks human
We hang side by side

lines.zh: 它飞起来的时候我笑了
lines.en: I laughed when it flew
Two shadows overlap

lines.zh: 我们一起绕树转了一圈
lines.en: We circle the tree together once
It flew off first
I stayed on the branch
This wood has room for two
Tomorrow I will see if it is still here
I grab it with my claws
My hands are not quite hands
If it falls, I fly down
This is heavier than I expected
I hold it in my mouth
I hang from the branch for it
It is stuck in the fork
I took it and let it go

lines.zh: 我抓起来看了看，又扔下。
lines.en: I grab it, look, and drop it again.
In this wood, it belongs to the wood
Someone is walking in the wood
I watched you walk in
You are under my tree
I spread my wings and fly down
I know every branch of this tree
You have not looked up yet
I am a little like you
I come from the far side of the canopy
I land on the branch ahead of you
You cast a shadow
I fly above you
No hurry, this wood is small

lines.zh: 你走一步，我跟着挪一格。
lines.en: One step from you, one block from me.

lines.zh: 我从一棵树换到另一棵
lines.en: I move from tree to tree
My wings make no sound
There is not enough light here

lines.zh: 你后颈那撮头发，我盯着。
lines.en: I stare at the tuft of hair on your nape.
I fly a little closer
I wait on this tree
You will turn your head

lines.zh: 我顶着人的脸，从树上落下。
lines.en: With a human face, I drop from the tree.
I claw at you once
That felt like a person's shove
I bit once, gently
Your shoulder was struck
I fly back up to the tree
My wing slapped your face

lines.zh: 我的爪子只划破你的领口。
lines.en: My claws only tear your collar.
The hit spun you half around

lines.zh: 幽魂橡木的枝上，我挂着看你。
lines.en: I hang on a ghost-oak branch and watch.

lines.zh: 我从幽魂橡木的树冠上下来
lines.en: I come down from the ghost oak canopy
One more on this tree now

lines.zh: 我飞起来的时候像个人
lines.en: I look like a person when I fly

lines.zh: 林子里有我这样的东西
lines.en: There are things like me in this wood
I circle the tree once first
My claws hook into the bark
The light here is very dim
I look down at the ground

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在树影里不像翅膀
lines.en: In the tree shadow my wings do not look like wings
I fly toward you
The firelit my wings brightly

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下去，翅膀翻着
lines.en: I fell from the tree, wings flailing
Water pinned my wings
The blast blew me off the branch

lines.zh: 飞来的东西从我翼上穿过去
lines.en: Something flying pierced my wing
That force dragged me down
Not hungry, but I have no strength

lines.zh: 雷光里我的影子像个人
lines.en: In the lightning my shadow looked like a person
There are no trees to perch on in the void
